config.text:
network:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 5000
  disable_auth: true
  disable_fetch_requests: true
  send_tracebacks: false
  api_servers: ["OAI"]
  sse_ping_interval: 15

logging:
  log_prompt: false
  log_generation_params: false
  log_requests: false
  log_chat_completion_requests: false

model:
  model_dir: /workspace/models
  inline_model_loading: false
  use_dummy_models: false
  model_name: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-EXL3-4bpw
  backend: exllamav3
  max_seq_len: 131073
  cache_size: 532480
  cache_mode: Q6
  tensor_parallel: false
  gpu_split_auto: true
  autosplit_reserve: [192]
  chunk_size: 2048
  output_chunking: true
  max_batch_size: 4

draft_model:
  draft_mode: disabled

sampling:
  override_preset:

memory:
  sysmem_recurrent_cache: 4096
  sysmem_kv_cache: 0
  cuda_malloc_async: true
